errors.text: The required critical threshold is 900 K, but the hypothesis declares it unknown and substitutes an analogy-based estimate near 840 K.
It does not reconstruct the central dislocation trend: relatively stable dislocation density at 300–600 K followed by a significant reduction at 900–1200 K.
It replaces the reported stacking-fault/HCP-to-lattice-disorder transition with an unsupported SRO-collapse, shear-band, and possible amorphization mechanism.
The cited studies concern different alloy systems and do not validate the claimed stacking-fault-energy evolution or order-disorder transition in FeNiCrCoCu.
